newsitem.title: CHINA: China to push development of poorer regions.
newsitem.headline: China to push development of poorer regions.

text.p: China has announced policies to speed development in poorer regions by attracting foreign investment and granting more authority to local governments, the China Securities said on Thursday.

The new policies would promote construction projects and exploitation of natural resources in central and western China, especially border regions and key inland cities, which have lagged behind the wealthier eastern coast.
Local governments in these areas would be given more flexibility in setting policies, it said, adding they would be allowed to seek foreign government credits or aid directly.
The new policies also permitted foreigners to manage medium- and large-scale production enterprises and scientific research laboratories in these regions, it said.
Goods produced under the state quota system in central and western China would be allocated to those regions.
The newspaper gave no further details.

Market-oriented economic reforms in the last 17 years have brought wealth and prosperity to many of China's coastal regions but left central and western parts of the country far behind in the rush for economic modernisation.
